rule: A company counts only if it is on the current Fortune 500 AND is, or owns, a FINRA member broker-dealer (owner's rule, 2026-11-21).

sources.fortune500: https://fortune.com/ranking/fortune500/ (2026 list; ranks 1-500 of the page's 1,000 companies)
sources.finra: FINRA BrokerCheck, https://brokercheck.finra.org/ (firm record https://brokercheck.finra.org/firm/summary/<CRD>; Form BD owners in https://files.brokercheck.finra.org/firm/firm_<CRD>.pdf)

howToEdit: An entry is used only when included is true AND it has a fortune500.rank from 1 to 500, at least one finra firm with a crd, and at least one alias. searchName is the company name sent to the listings API. aliases are employer names as they appear on listings: lower case, matched as whole words inside the listing's employer name, so keep them specific (aliasesLeftOut lists short or ambiguous names that were deliberately not used). To drop a company set included to false and say why in excludedReason. Review the whole list when a new Fortune 500 is published (yearly) and update compiledOn.
notConfirmed: searchName and aliases are best guesses from the Fortune and BrokerCheck names; they were not checked against the listings API. Companies outside Fortune's Financials sector were not screened, apart from a few fintech names. For excluded companies, a broker-dealer under an unrelated name would not have been found.
